label: lem:continuous_at_interior
title: Continuity at interior points
statement: If $f$ is continuous on $[\min(a,b), \max(a,b)]$ and $x$ lies in the interior, then $f$ is continuous at $x$. Indeed, the closed interval is a neighborhood of any interior point (\texttt{Icc\_mem\_nhds}), so continuity on the set implies pointwise continuity.
